invariants.rationale: If a method is returned, its name must equal the requested name; otherwise, result is null.
The ClassReflection.getMethods call with 'type' implies that 'type' is not null at this point.
If a result is returned, its declaring class should be equal to the given 'type' parameter since methods are sought from this class.
If a Method result is found, it must have been compared to name, so name cannot be null in such a path.
